params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch consistently renames all field names from uppercase with underscores (e.g., DIMENSION, MIN_LEAF_SIZE) to camelCase (e.g., dimension, minLeafSize), which directly addresses the SonarQube warning about field naming conventions. All changes are limited to renaming fields and updating their usages accordingly, without introducing any unrelated modifications or functional changes. The patch does not add or remove any code beyond what is necessary to fix the naming convention issue.
